notes: כֹּל takes the distributive *Every*; the ASV writes no *of* between the quantifier and its noun, so rule 19's quantifying-construct sentence has nothing to place, and the supplied generic *man* joins עָרוּם with the head on the word carrying the lexeme under rule 31.
The italic *his* is added under rule 18's closing sentence, no possessive morpheme standing on אִוֶּלֶת.
